notes.title: Surprise Weapons Update for Pistol Whip’s Fourth Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Hey Action Heroes!

Four years ago, we launched Pistol Whip as an on-rails action-rhythm VR game, inspired by some of the most iconic action movies. Since then, we’ve updated the game every single year with free updates for the Pistol Whip community.

We added tons of new features to the game, dozens of new Scenes (did you know we now have over 35 Scenes available to play?), new music genres, Cinematic Campaigns, the highly requested community Remixes (mods), an official modding tool, and so much more to keep you coming back to your headsets.

This year, we’re marking our anniversary by dropping a surprise update, and gifting players with a little something extra for the occasion!

[h2]Drive the beat of your favourite Pistol Whip Scenes with the new Drum Gun![/h2]

More instrument than gun, the ‘Drum Gun’ is an all-new weapon type for even the most seasoned Heroes (and drummers) out there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/1d4e84549288bf8fd7d625744bc055fb3115a7f9.gif[/img]

Craft your own music with this rhythm-infused weapon, where each shot, hit, or reload will make a different sound. Moving your hand to different locations changes the sound of your shots! 

[b]Check out the visual guide below for details:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/faed969a82812033c4b0a7480c85426c841ad38e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Four bullets on reload? Check.
[*] Cymbal sound effects on reload or when whipping an enemy? Check.
[*] A killer gun so you can feel like you're part of the band? Double (bass) check.
[/list]
The Sonar SQ2 Drum Gun is available now in the gun case.

[h2]Behold: Three Other New Shiny Weapons[/h2]

We heard your feedback about how much you loved Overdrive’s Majesty Scene, with the ability to dual-wield crossbows. So, how about playing with a few other weapons inspired by the Scene?

We've added three new weapons to the game, each expertly crafted by our blacksmiths...er, we mean devs. Find them in the gun case under their specific weapon types:

[list]
[*] Metal Gauntlet (Brawler)
[*] Dragon Sword (Brawler)
[*] Witch Pistol (Revolver)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/659258b11e68928dc9714ecf62aef1504c9481fa.gif[/img]

Thank you to all of our Action Heroes for your continued love and support. Enjoy the new weapons update!

Love,
Cloudhead Games

notes.title: Join the Party in Pistol Whip’s Latest Update, Encore!
notes.notes:
[h2]Action Heroes![/h2]

Your favourite action-rhythm FPS is back at it again with a very special Encore for you! Filled with more of the stuff you love, players can now enjoy new scenes, modifiers, and of course our highly-requested new way to play with friends, in Party Mode.

Enjoy some eye-catching improvements to your Pistol Whip experience with refreshed menus, new winter weapon wraps, and killer upgrades to our modifiers including Targets, No Beat, and Rhythmic!

[previewyoutube=41bzfBLidr0;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h2]Join the Party with our Exciting New Mode![/h2]

You asked, and we delivered. Introducing Party Mode! Compete with friends and family with personalized challenges. Change up scenes and modifiers to see who will reign supreme. 
 
Play through scenes customized to your specifications. Once your score is counted, use the keyboard (exclusive to Party Mode!) to secure your name of choice and reveal it in all its glory! Once your name has been added to the leaderboard unique to Party Mode, pass on the headset to the next challenger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/94c66112f534e572e7c679dfc1144c00e320d4b7.gif[/img]
 
[h2]An “Encore” for 2089 and Smoke & Thunder[/h2]
 
Jump back into the post-apocalyptic world of 2089 and the Wild West of Smoke & Thunder, with two new scenes! Starring fan-favourite tracks from the credits of these action-packed story-driven cinematic campaigns, fans can now enjoy the thrilling songs by Devora and Magic Sword with their own unique scenes. Whether you want to slay robots to the beat of The Way Home or live the life of an outlaw to the tune of Fist Fight, we’ve got you covered.
 
If you haven’t checked out the cinematic campaigns yet, be sure to swing by the campaigns in-headset to immerse yourself in these Pistol Whip stories! Become the hero of a gritty sci-fi apocalyptic future or be the ultimate gunslinger in a Wild West sci-fi fusion at the press of a button!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/2ea86c50531ae6dae6bb83ee1b1dc55cf80383c4.gif[/img]
 
[h2]The Styles System: Play Your Way with Targets, No Beat, and Rhythmic[/h2]
 
Players can now change up the scoring system to allow for an even more customizable experience! With No Beat and Rhythmic, heroes can now choose if their score is entirely focused on accuracy or shooting to the beat of the music. Along with these new scoring system modifiers, heroes will also be able to use the Targets modifier to turn enemies into abstract targets. Create your own badass training experience by combining the Target, Deadeye, and Threatless modifiers together.
 
 [u][b]No Beat:[/b][/u] Take the rhythm out of the equation with this modifier. When enabled, your scores are determined entirely by the accuracy of your shots - no musicality required!
 
[u][b]Rhythmic:[/b][/u] Lose yourself in the groove - with this modifier, scores are determined entirely by shooting to the beat!
 
[u][b]Targets:[/b][/u] Is target-shooting more your style? Select this modifier to transform enemies into non-human targets throughout all of your favorite scenes (Arcade and Party Modes only!) Combine Targets with other modifiers to completely change the feel of the game. (For example, try Targets plus Threatless and No Beat to change any level into a true shooting range experience!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/8192899a9d9e28ff6a9d930e9589efdbd74a22f3.gif[/img]
 
[h2]New Weapons and Wraps![/h2]

Stay frosty with some cool new winter wraps and weapons! Featuring the 39 Special, 357 Python, and the Hippo.

notes.title: New Action Available Now in Pistol Whip's Wildest Update Ever!
notes.notes:
[h3]Howdy heroes! [/h3]

We are excited for you to get your lassos around our wildest update ever, out now. Containing both [b][i]Pistol Whip[/i][/b]’s second cinematic campaign, "Smoke & Thunder," as well as the game-changing Styles system sandbox, this one is [i]exploding[/i] with new content for you to check out. Let’s go ahead and take a gander at what you can expect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/9c0170c148b1e93693d3aa2ac21b794c225501b7.png[/img]
[i]A notorious gunslinger re-emerges to roam the Wild West in search of her missing sister, unwinding a deep conspiracy, known only as DYNAMO, on the cusp of the industrial boom.[/i]

[h3]Smoke & Thunder[/h3]
After "2089," the transmission came through loud and clear: y’all wanted more. With "Smoke & Thunder," we are giving you just that—another action-packed cinematic campaign bursting at the seams with as much content as we could fit into five linked scenes. With new weapons, mechanics, a dastardly new outlaw threat, and a mighty fine new boss fight for folks to tangle with. 

Featuring tracks from The Heavy, Devora, Black Pistol Fire, Bones UK, and an original never-before-heard track from Magic Sword, this five-scene cinematic campaign is [i]abso-rootin'-tootin'-lutely[/i] exploding with exciting new content. So, saddle up and unravel the mystery awaiting you in the Wild West. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/c15f2711fc69295e31ad49b91cc9bc55fb35b0b7.gif[/img]

Playing "Smoke & Thunder" in Campaign mode immerses you in the story, equipping you with intended weapons and modifiers, transforming you into the hero, and allowing you to experience the fully-voiced tale of sisters Jessie (voiced by Victoria Hogan, [i]Kingdom Come: Deliverance[/i]) and Tess (voiced by Avalon Penrose, [i]Hades[/i], GOTY). It’s a visually stunning experience, illustrated with cutscene cinematics created by fan-favourite comic artist and returning talent, Fico Ossio, and colourist Raciel Avila. 

Once you've conquered the campaign, skedaddle on over to Arcade and check out all the campaign scenes--from "Smoke & Thunder" as well as "2089"--unbridled for the very first time. In Arcade mode you can use whatever weapon and modifier you want, in whatever order you want, for boundless replayability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/d9319ded814fc06891cb27a603117d1c5a34723c.gif[/img]

[h3]Styles let you create the gameplay YOU want.[/h3]
[b][i]Pistol Whip[/i][/b]’s new “Styles” system sandbox allows you to combine your preferred weapon type with up to five modifiers to create an unstoppable action experience that’s exactly what you want. After finding a preferred Style that’s uniquely your own, you can challenge friends or compete solo and be the first person to dominate the leaderboard uniquely generated for that Style.

New weapon types also burst onto the scene with the debut of Styles, including Brawler, which transforms the previous "No Ammo" modifier into a glorious new melee-only mode. "2089"’s Burstfire and the new weapons from “Smoke & Thunder” are also available in all scenes with Styles. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/beaad5f6954d31254f84db81ac6e358aa06e4486.gif[/img]

These weapon additions and changes combined with four new modifiers mean the possibilities are endless. From green to grizzled and anywhere in-between, there’s a Style for you. Pistol Whip also includes an ever-changing list of recommendations, such as Featured Styles which contain weekly Style choices curated by our own team of developers and players. “Styles” can also be used with all past [i][b]Pistol Whip[/b][/i] updates like the aforementioned “2089” and “Heartbreaker.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/4aa380a7924d81766e98ae0cd66f740f75771202.gif[/img]

[h3]Price Change[/h3]
In just three more days, on August 15th, the price of Pistol Whip will increase by $5 in order to further support the creation of epic content and updates. After August 15th, [i][b]Pistol Whip[/b][/i] will be available for $29.99. This price increase will not impact existing heroes.

To learn more about everything we have added to [i][b]Pistol Whip[/b][/i] since launch, check out our “Everything New in Pistol Whip" trailer.

notes.notes:
[h2]About 2089[/h2]
The robot-plagued future is here, and it needs the perfect hero. It needs you. 2089, our first-ever cinematic campaign featuring a gritty sci-fi story and five linked scenes is our biggest update yet! Become John Asimov, as you use new weapons to survive an off-world plague of killer machines and unravel the mystery behind their violent uprising, all set to a sweet synth-wave inspired soundtrack.

This update also sees a complete overhaul of the user interface, LIV integration upgrades, some improvements to enemy behaviors, as well as reactivation of the “You’re Breathtaking” achievement. ːenteringsteamvrː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/4db5be6e564019944fd10bc520c732e093450a6d.gif[/img]

[h2]A new story-rich cinematic experience [/h2]
Featuring tracks from Black Tiger Sex Machine, Draeden, Processor, and an exclusive remix from the legendary Magic Sword, the five linked scenes--played in order--make up the most we’ve dropped simultaneously, [i]ever[/i]. 

The campaign is illustrated through immersive cinematics by Comic Artist and Creator Fico Ossio, who has helped to bring life to some of our favourite heroes, including G.I.JOE, Transformers, TMNT, and Spider-Man. The campaign, inspired by some of our favourite 80’s science fiction films, also includes new enemies, weapons, models, mechanics, and more.

Developer Cloudhead Games' critically acclaimed rhythm FPS is finally making the jump from PC to PlayStation 4, and will be available on PSVR on 28th July.

Pistol Whip released at the tail-end of last year on PC and immediately drew praise for its mesmerising, music-driven first-person shooter action - a breathlessly balletic, high-intensity mix of dodging, ducking, blasting, and high-score combo chasing, with the end result doing for virtual guns what Beat Saber did for twirling neon sticks around like a caffeinated majorette.

Today we’re putting the pedal to the metal with Full Throttle, our biggest update yet, packed with a hardcore Mad Max-inspired new scene, two new modifiers, and new customization options to boot. Fans of "Black Magic" and "Death" will recognize LeKtriQue who’s back for his third Pistol Whip scene alongside Midnight CVLT in Full Throttle. Shoot, dodge, and whip your way through the desert in the midst of a rampaging vehicular rally filled with surprises along the way. Full Throttle is our hardest scene yet, and is the first to introduce scene events, a new way for us to add synchronized animations to scenes for spectacular flair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35882631/f2564c8e287345b2ccc86ddb46f4f5df62f505c0.gif[/img]

This gives you a new way to tackle the enemy density of harder difficulties without needing the fastest trigger finger in the west.

Our second new modifier, Scavenger, is a whole new way to play. With Scavenger, the only way you can reload your weapon is by pistol whipping -- if you want ammo, you’ll have to take it. This modifier can make it difficult just to get through scenes, and adds new strategy as you conserve ammo, dodge more, and pistol whip any chance you get. 

We’ve also added a bunch of new customization options, including the Tac-Ops weapon collection featuring three new pistols. Check your gun crate for 5 new wraps (including companions for High Priestess, Akuma, and Full Throttle), 3 new colours and metals (including the long awaited Gold), and a slappy new SFX option inspired by the pistol in Half-Life 2.

Today we're launching our first free update to Pistol Whip, including a killer new scene (complete with three difficulties), 2 new modifiers, and scoring improvements to Deadeye and Dual Wield. 

Inspired by the hallway fight scene in the movie Oldboy, "The High Priestess" is a melee-heavy scene that puts the name into Pistol Whip--bash your way through a synchronized gauntlet in this punchy new track by Sam Lamar & CMOR. Fans of our Gallery adventure series ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5046/The_Gallery__EP1_Call_of_the_Starseed__EP2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/]60% off during the Winter Sale[/url]) might even see some familiar faces...

For Deadeye and Dual Wield, we've heard your feedback and have made some scoring adjustments as a first step. First, players wanted Deadeye to be more punishing for missed shots, so we revamped the scoring system to account for misses, creating a larger delta in player performance. Deadeye hitboxes have also been repaired -- thank you for the reports!

Next, players felt the Dual Wield modifier penalty was too strict, so we've brought it down to -10% from -25%. We'll see how this change affects scores and determine whether we can eliminate the penalty altogether. In the future, we also plan to add leaderboard filtering so you can earn top scores regardless of your modifiers.

With the new scene and scoring changes, we're initiating a one-time-only leaderboard reset so players can start fresh and chase new scores with friends over the holiday season.

notes.title: Free new scene coming December 19!
notes.notes:
Wow. Thank you all for an incredible first few weeks. Pistol Whip is officially one of the highest-rated VR games of the year! Thank you for trusting us to deliver a unique experience in VR—something familiar but different. We've been loving all the different videos and seeing all the different ways the game can be played, from tactical to musical, from shooter to rhythm.

We want to keep Pistol Whip alive; we've been cataloging feedback, chasing bugs, and starting work on our first big content update. We plan to post regular announcements to the community on our progress as we work out our roadmap.

Announced this morning, we'll be releasing our first major update on December 19, including a new scene inspired by the hallway fight in the movie "Oldboy." Check out the video we did below for the UploadVR Holiday VR Showcase.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1PInkAiZX1g

Also included in the December 19 update are two new modifiers: No Obstacles and Shooting Gallery, expanding the accessibility of the game and offering a new way to practice scenes without the risk of being eliminated.

Beyond December, we plan to add more free scenes, modifiers, unlockables, achievements, and even an Expert difficulty. Improvements to the Deadeye modifier are also in the works.

Please continue to leave feedback in your reviews and forum posts and make sure to share the game with your friends and family over the upcoming holidays. If you love the game, you can even throw us a vote for "VR Game of the Year" in the annual Steam Awards, ongoing now!

Thanks again for all your support, and we can't wait for you to play High Priestess on December 19.

Love,
